loops.name: cloud-dispatch
loops.title: Loop engine dispatcher
loops.purpose: The one claude.ai routine for all cloud jobs. Fires at 01:45 and 06:45, while Nassim sleeps, so loop work never uses up his daytime usage limit. Runs whichever jobs are due (scripts/due_jobs.py).

loops.name: cloud-maintenance
loops.title: Loop: maintenance
loops.purpose: Merge green dependency updates and green agent PRs, fix red CI, resolve conflicts, across all repos.

loops.name: cloud-kinz-analyst
loops.title: Loop: KINZ competitor analyst
loops.purpose: Read-only check of the weekly KINZ scrape data; runs the night after Monday's scrape. Writes findings only.

loops.name: cloud-improvements
loops.title: Loop: improvements
loops.purpose: Top improvement-list item on 2 repos by rotation; refill a repo's list when it runs low. Merges when green.

loops.name: cloud-kinz-improvement
loops.title: Loop: Kinz accounting improvement
loops.purpose: Kinz accounting repo improvement pass: 1-3 well-tested fixes, merged when green. Figure-changing PRs wait for Nassim.

loops.name: cloud-creative
loops.title: Loop: creative idea
loops.purpose: One new idea in one repo; a fresh Opus agent checks it against a goal written first. Merges if verified and green.

loops.name: cloud-daily-commit
loops.title: Loop: daily commit
loops.purpose: Only if nothing landed today: one small, real fix, merged when green. Runs after the night jobs.

loops.name: cloud-weekly-summary
loops.title: Loop: weekly summary
loops.purpose: Weekly report on Monday morning: what merged, what failed, what never ran, what's next.

loops.name: repo-genesis-loop
loops.title: Laptop: new repo (genesis)
loops.purpose: Every 28 days, create one new private repo coherent with the portfolio. Stays on the laptop: cloud sessions cannot create repos.

calendar.note: Timer fires weekly; the prompt's 28-day gate decides. The calendar shows only the days it acts.

loops.name: zai-keep-going
loops.title: Z.ai: keep going
loops.purpose: Z.ai work session on repos where registry worked_by == 'zai'. Paused until Z.ai has its own GitHub account.
